The Refined approach

Good care is
in the details.

Your car goes through a lot. From daily commutes to weekend drives, it deserves a little time and attention.

Refined Detailing brings that care to your place. Hand-washed exteriors, properly cleaned interiors and straightforward service — all from a mobile business based in Eleebana.

Choose the service that suits your car. We’ll confirm the details, bring the equipment and let you know when it’s ready.

Before your detail

A few
good questions.

Something else on your mind?

Call 0431 484 541
What do I need at the location?

Suitable parking, access to an outdoor tap and a power point. We bring the equipment for your detail.

Is my booking confirmed straight away?

Your booking form prepares a text enquiry. Refined will reply to confirm your service, price, location and appointment time.

Can you clean a car with pet hair or heavy dirt?

Tell us what your car needs in the booking notes. Extra work for pet hair, mud or spills may affect the price, and any additional cost is agreed before we begin.

How do I pay?

Pay on completion by cash or bank transfer.
